hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: PangeaFeeHook charges a fixed swap fee (0.3%–5%, set at pool registration and immutable thereafter) in the quote asset via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims redeemable to a per-pool fee splitter. A designated devBuyer address pays no fee on the first swap. Only the LiquidityLocker may add liquidity; swaps that move the price past the launch range edge are reverted.
